usage: icebath skin [-h] {list,use,set} ...

Manage Icebath skins. `set` tweaks one color of the active skin in place.

positional arguments:
  {list,use,set}
    list          List available skins
    use           Switch the active skin
    set           Set one color of the active skin (e.g. `skin set ui_tool '#00FFFF'`)

options:
  -h, --help      show this help message and exit
